A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Semantic Discrepancy-aware Detector (SDD). Their complete main texts, Appendices A–J, equations, tables, and figures are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original SDD results on UnivFD and SynRIS, component ablations, and supplementary robustness, backbone, tampering, and computational-cost experiments.

after.justification: v3 retains original SDD benchmark results and ablations, together with the original experimental analyses in Appendices A–J.

M1.justification: Equation (13) changes F_low(n) from F'(n) + F'(n)/e_n to F(n) + F(n)/e_n. Because Equation (11) distinguishes the semantic-modulated F' from F, this changes the specified enhancer computation. The remaining architecture and losses are unchanged; whether the implementation changed is not established.

E1.justification: Both retain ProGAN and Stable Diffusion v1/LAION training, UnivFD and SynRIS evaluation, and the MAGICBRUSH tampering study in Appendix H. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in each corresponding comparison. For example, Co-occurrence remains in Tables 1–2, FakeInversion remains in Table 3, and the smaller comparator sets in Tables 5–6 are retained.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 changes the stated initial learning rate from 1 × 10^-4 to 1 × 10^-5. This is a reported training-setting revision, without evidence that experiments were rerun. Other stated settings, evaluation metrics, and testing procedures remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The component and weighting-function ablations, sampling sensitivity, blur/JPEG robustness, backbone comparisons, attention and latent-space analyses, tampering study, and computational-cost analysis are retained without changes to their questions or evidence.

E5.justification: Appendix C specifies random seed 46 in both versions. Neither version adds repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, significance tests, or another uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: Tables 1–8 and the plotted and qualitative results are unchanged. Tables 1–3 retain SDD's 98.51% mAP and 93.61% accuracy on UnivFD and 95.1% AUROC on SynRIS. No new or replacement results accompany the equation and learning-rate revisions.

T1.justification: Equation (13)'s mathematical definition of the enhanced feature changes from primed to unprimed features. Given their distinct definition in Equation (11), this is not equivalent notation. Other mathematical definitions and derivations remain unchanged, with no added proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about visual-only semantic/forgery alignment, reconstruction learning, low-level feature enhancement, and superior generalization on the two benchmarks.

C2.justification: The semantic-mechanism explanations, interpretations of the benchmark and backbone results, and qualifications concerning blur sensitivity and limited tampering localization remain unchanged. No new explanation accompanies the equation or learning-rate edits.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 revises the disclosed initial learning rate to 10^-5, while Appendix C retains 10^-4 in its training description. Hardware, augmentation instructions, remaining hyperparameters, and the code-access statement are unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 60 references and research positioning are retained, including the distinctions from UnivFD, FatFormer, and earlier reconstruction-based detectors. No cited work or substantive novelty comparison is added or removed.

P1.justification: Limited copyedits replace 'Appendix A/B' with 'Sec. A/B' and adjust capitalization in the space definitions. The arXiv version/date header also changes. The narrative, section order, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All 15 figures and 8 tables retain their visual content, captions, organization, and placement, including the supplementary plots and heatmaps. No display is added, removed, redrawn, or reorganized.

improvement.justification: The equation and learning-rate revisions could be corrections, but neither PDF explains their relationship to the unchanged results. Section 4.1 now specifies 10^-5 while Appendix C retains 10^-4 in its baseline-oriented training description, without clarifying their relationship. Whether these edits improve correctness or introduce inconsistencies remains unresolved, preventing a reliable overall quality judgment.
